heading: Your clients book in <highlight>4 steps.</highlight>
description: No apps to download. No long forms. Just one link you can share on WhatsApp, Instagram, or Google.

steps.alt: Step 1: Select services and staff member
steps.title: Choose a service and specialist
steps.desc: The client selects one or more services and their favorite specialist, or lets the system assign whoever's available.

steps.title: Pick a date and time
steps.desc: See real-time availability by staff member or across the whole team, even on different days if the client books multiple services.

steps.title: Confirm the summary
steps.desc: The client reviews services, specialist, date, time, and price before confirming — everything at a glance.

steps.title: Appointment confirmed instantly
steps.desc: The booking is confirmed automatically or goes to approval, depending on your settings. WhatsApp notifies the client.

highlights.label: Available 24/7
highlights.sub: Bookings with no set business hours

highlights.label: No extra apps
highlights.sub: Just one link you can share
